services.title: Answer Engine Optimisation & SEO

hero.lede: Buyers still search Google — but more of them now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or Google's AI Overviews and act on the answer. We make sure your business is the one that answer names, combining technical SEO, answer-first content and Answer Engine Optimisation.

definition.heading: What is Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)?
definition.body: Answer Engine Optimisation is the practice of structuring a website so AI-powered answer engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews — can understand it, trust it and quote it. Where SEO earns a position in a list of links, AEO earns a mention inside the answer itself. The two share foundations: crawlable pages, clear entities, and content that genuinely answers the question being asked.

entries.title: Missing from AI answers

entries.title: Traffic that doesn't convert

faqs.q: What is the difference between AEO and SEO?
faqs.a: SEO optimises pages to rank in search results. AEO optimises the same content so AI answer engines can extract and cite it in a direct answer. Good AEO is built on good SEO, so we deliver them together.

faqs.q: Which AI engines do you optimise for?
faqs.a: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini and AI Overviews, and Microsoft Copilot. They draw on different sources, so we track visibility in each.

faqs.q: How long before we see results?
faqs.a: Technical fixes can show impact within weeks. Rankings and AI citations for competitive questions usually build over three to six months of consistent work.

faqs.q: Do you write the content, or do we?
faqs.a: Either. We can write everything, or brief your team and edit what they produce. Most clients choose a mix.

faqs.q: How do you report on AI visibility?
faqs.a: We run a fixed set of buyer questions through each answer engine every month and record whether, and how, your business is mentioned — alongside Google rankings and enquiries.

cta.heading: Want to be the answer — on Google and in AI search?
cta.body: Start with a free AEO audit. We'll show you where you rank, whether AI engines mention you, and what to fix first.

faqs.q: What do you build websites with?
faqs.a: It depends on the job. For most marketing sites we build lean, statically generated pages deployed to AWS Amplify — fast, secure and inexpensive to host. For more complex needs we use modern frameworks such as Next.js and React.

faqs.q: Can you improve our existing site instead of rebuilding it?
faqs.a: Yes. If the foundations are sound, targeted improvements to speed, structure and content are often the better investment. We'll tell you honestly which route makes sense.

faqs.q: Will we lose our Google rankings if we rebuild?
faqs.a: Not if it's done properly. We map every existing address and keep or redirect it, so the authority your pages have earned carries over.

faqs.q: How long does a website project take?
faqs.a: A focused marketing site typically takes four to eight weeks. Larger sites with extensive content migration take longer; we'll give you a timeline at the scoping stage.

cta.heading: Ready for a website that works as hard as you do?
cta.body: Tell us about your current site and what you need it to achieve. We'll come back with a clear plan.
